answer_1.quote: We conduct a systematic evaluation to investigate the translationese patterns exhibited by LLMs... We consider English‑Chinese and German‑English translations.

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity (PPL) as an effective indicator of generation naturalness. We also consider lexical density (Lex.) and length variance (Len.) and report COMET-QE scores.

answer_4.quote: We ask the three expert translators to rank translations generated by different models... Annotators identify and annotate spans with translationese errors and rank translations according to naturalness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators highlight spans exhibiting translationese (unnatural sentence flow, unnatural phrase flow) and then rank the overall translations based on naturalness.
